name: nighthawk-webbridge
description: Control your real browser (with your login sessions) from NightHawk via the local NightHawk WebBridge daemon — navigate, click, type, read pages, and screenshot any website.
author: NightHawk Contributors

interface.shortDescription: Control your real browser from NightHawk — navigate, click, type, and screenshot
interface.longDescription:
NightHawk WebBridge lets AI control the user's real browser — navigate, click, type, read, screenshot, and interact with any website using the user's actual login sessions. The skill talks to the local WebBridge daemon (http://127.0.0.1:10086), which drives Chrome/Edge through a browser extension over CDP. Everything runs locally; login state and page content never leave the device.

Requires the NightHawk WebBridge daemon and browser extension — get them from your NightHawk distribution.
